body:
Reporting shipped in #253 (see that PR for what the review corrected). `just report-hydrate-grounding` now lists the 16 records whose term is anhydrous but which carry a hydrate synonym, with the full synonym lists in `reports/hydrate_synonyms.tsv`, and says which are already tracked in the duplicate-identifier baseline — **10 known, 5 new to any check**.

Keeping this open for the **triage**: per Section 3 most of the 16 should be split out with their own identifier, but several came from merges in #214/#226 that may need reversing, and some synonyms are just another spelling of the hydration state the record already represents.

The related population — records whose own label is a hydrate but which carry a synonym naming a *different* hydration state — is **#254**. I attempted it here and shipped 96 findings that were almost all false, so it needs a tested multiplicity parser first.
